newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's real drops 0.06 pct in calm trading.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's real drops 0.06 pct in calm trading.

text.p: Brazil's real dropped 0.06 percent in calm trading to close at 1.0739 per dollar on the commercial foreign exchange market on expectations of a decline in the reais-dollar mini-band, dealers said.
The current mini-band was set by the Central Bank on June 12 at between 1.0730 and 1.0780 reais per dollar and traders anticipate a 0.1 percent decline between Wednesday and Thursday.
In the interbank floating rate market, the real closed at 1.0785 per greenback, up 0.04 percent.
In the parallel market, the real fell 0.27 percent to end at 1.133 per dollar, traders said.
